title: hoa.process~
description: `hoa.process~` is a patch loader for modular multichannel processing, acting like a `poly~`-style container for harmonic or planewave instances with corresponding multichannel signal inputs and outputs. Its arguments specify the decomposition order or instance count, process patch, domain, and per-instance arguments; target selectors such as `#*`, `#1`, or `#2-4` route messages to selected instances.
